notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34412799/33e53bda4c3bdb37af8aa70126780dc2a007f623.png
This patch completes Allien’s claim quest. This is pretty much it for this game.
This game was never meant to be long because it originally started out as a tech demo for another game I’ve been working on. 10-hour game play time was my original target.
Due to the game’s simple damage calculations and other factors, I cannot take the game further even if I wanted.

The real ending to Allen’s quest lies in its sequel, Bhavacakra Maco.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34412799/ceae71fd9f13cb9ff240295351b6ec2e7d1fc70f.png

I thank you for those who played this game.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34412799/e386b78ae434796680fce76e1a55f2d54bfac345.png

This can be considered an expansion pack to the game.
This patch adds a new town, a new outfield zone, and a new dungeon to explore. They are all post-game content, meaning you must clear the game to be able to access this content.
As of 1.1.0, this new dungeon is 50% complete. Further update will see another new city and several side quests as well as a fan service scene. 


 A new companions are added and he is virtually useless.

 A new port town, Kyye is added. This is a Baldarian city, meaning the living and undead live in harmony.

 An outfield zone, Kyye desert, is added, featuring new monsters to fight.

 Necromancer’s tomb (a dungeon) is added.

 A new title screen is added.

  Due to new content and new monsters, I’ve added few more skills to all characters. Previously, all characters had no further skills to learn after level 22. Now, new skills are available until level 30. (35 for Grace)

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Those who have reached the three endings may have met Allen who speaks of some gibberish about a possible quest. That quest has not been abandoned but its progress is depended on stories I will have to come up with its sequel which is not ready, which also means I don’t know when I will begin working on it.

Anyway, this patch adjusts...
1. Monster chase speed when they spot you has been reduced by one level for most and two levels for bigger creatures.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
There have been some complaints about not being able to proceed in the early stage of the game due to not being able to harvest.

Now, this is not a bug. There are 3 animated small stars on the spots where you can harvest and those stars are all over the maps.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34412799/7431e6eb6842367d2d0379afa2e0bb03dfb096fd.jpg

This version replaces these small stars with an icon that cannot be missed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34412799/d3010e51bc8b340923114f4c798ee54dde231bd3.jpg

But those icons are rather distracting in my view, so the new icon exists only on the first map. Other maps retain the original small stars.

Hope this helps.
